nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of every account in ERC20.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) tracking spending allowances in ERC20.
Private uint256 holding the total amount of tokens in existence, increased by _mint.
Private uint8 token decimals, initialised to 18 in the ERC20 constructor and read by decimals().
SubToken constructor that forwards name/symbol to ERC20 and mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
Internal virtual function that creates amount tokens for account and increases _totalSupply.
Public transfer of amount tokens from _msgSender() to recipient via _transfer.
Public transfer of amount from sender to recipient using the caller's allowance.
Public approval setting spender allowance over the caller's tokens via _approve.
Internal virtual function moving balances between sender and recipient and emitting Transfer.
Internal virtual function writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Caller-controlled address used as mint beneficiary in the constructor and as owner/spender in ERC20 functions.
Arithmetic expression '120000000 * 18 ** uint(decimals())' computing the minted amount; uses 18**decimals instead of 10**decimals and performs unchecked multiplication.
State update sequence inside _mint that writes _totalSupply and _balances[account] with the supplied amount.
Constructor string parameter name (shadowed/ignored, literal SUBTOKEN is used instead).
Constructor string parameter symbol (shadowed/ignored, literal SBX is used instead).
Address receiving newly minted tokens in _mint.
Number of tokens to mint in _mint.
Destination address of a transfer.
Amount of tokens moved by transfer.
Address granted allowance by approve.
Allowance value set by approve.
Account whose balance is debited in transferFrom.
Account credited in transferFrom.
Amount moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the beneficiary of _mint inside the SubToken constructor, so the untrusted caller controls the initial supply recipient.
The SubToken constructor invokes ERC20._mint to create the initial token supply.
_mint performs the state-update sequence that writes _totalSupply and _balances.
The mint state update writes the recipient balance in _balances.
The mint state update increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
The computed mint amount (120000000 * 18 ** uint(decimals())) flows directly into _mint as the amount argument.
decimals() reads the _decimals state variable and feeds it into the exponent of the mint amount expression.
Constructor parameter name is consumed by the constructor call to the ERC20 base constructor.
Constructor parameter symbol is consumed by the constructor's base initialisation.
_mint account parameter determines which balance mapping slot is credited.
_mint amount parameter is added to both the total supply and the account balance.
transfer delegates the state mutation to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to deduct the used allowance.
approve delegates the allowance write to the internal _approve function.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the allowance mapping for owner and spender.
transfer passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender argument of _transfer.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
approve uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the owner granting the allowance.
msg.sender reaches _transfer as the sender argument when invoked through transfer.
transfer recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer and credited in _balances.
transfer amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer and used in the balance arithmetic.
approve spender parameter is forwarded to _approve and written into _allowances.
approve amount parameter is forwarded to _approve as the new allowance.
transferFrom sender parameter is debited by _transfer and reduced in allowance.
transferFrom recipient parameter receives the transferred balance.
transferFrom amount parameter is used both for the transfer and the allowance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: The name parameter only feeds the constructor's base-class initialisation call and carries no independent state, so it is folded into the constructor node.
The symbol parameter is only used for the ERC20 base constructor invocation and is folded into the constructor node.
The account parameter is the direct input that selects the credited balance slot inside _mint, so it merges into the _mint function node.
The amount parameter drives the total supply and balance increments in _mint, so it merges into the _mint function node.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by transfer when calling _transfer, so it merges into the transfer function node.
The amount parameter is only forwarded from transfer to _transfer, so it merges into the transfer function node.
The spender parameter is only forwarded from approve to _approve, so it merges into the approve function node.
The amount parameter is the allowance value set by approve and merges into the approve function node.
The sender parameter is only used within transferFrom to move and deduct allowance, so it merges into the transferFrom function node.
The recipient parameter is only consumed inside transferFrom and merges into that function node.
The amount parameter is processed exclusively inside transferFrom and merges into that function node.
